title: `PoolHarness.getCurrScaledVariableDebt` reads from `reserve.cache()` without triggering a fresh index update
impact: `reserve.cache()` snapshots `currScaledVariableDebt` from the last `updateState()` call. If `getCurrScaledVariableDebt` is called between a borrow/repay and the next index update (or during a flash-loan callback where the reserve state has not been refreshed), it returns a stale value.
